title: Origin classification missing at Entity IC exit
thresholds_source: docs/decisions/2026-08-24-class-c-decisions.md (gd-0024-class-c-decisions); var seeded by migration 0027 per ADR-0064 + origin_classification_missing_at_entity_ic_exit wording (ADR-0060)
notes: declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until thresholds are set (design Decision 8). Interim guard until PR-5 routing lands: this conditional procedure (applies_when origin in {internal, joint}) cannot route without the ADR-0047 origin axis; a missing classification halts rather than defaults to skip — a skip would be a waiver with none of a waiver's controls (ADR-0047). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; is_null-over-routing-var trap: project.origin exists in the registry but is never snapshotted, so is_null over it is ALWAYS true (a false-halt machine) — stays inert until an explicit mirror/computed-var decision. ADR-0064 resolves the row-19 engine-domain gap via a COMPUTED var over project_case_classification (live rows, superseded excluded) — NOT an is_null over the never-snapshotted routing var, so the false-halt machine trap does not apply; zero live rows at this gate trips the escalation.
